hub.faq.url.q: What types of QR codes can I generate?
hub.faq.url.a: URL, WiFi, vCard, Email, Phone, SMS, and Location. All 7 types are free.
hub.faq.free.a: Yes, completely free. No signup, no watermark, no limits.
hub.faq.privacy.a: All generation happens in your browser. Your content is never uploaded to any server.
hub.faq.format.a: PNG for photos/print, SVG for high-quality scaling, JPG for smaller file size.
hub.faq.logo.a: Yes. Upload any image; we composite it in the center. Error correction auto-promotes to H for scannability.
